Name: Panda Hat
Author: RyukanoHi
Description:
All I did here was use Content Patcher to replace the Fedora with the Panda Hat that is already in the game files. There's a Hat Coordinates.txt included in the zip that can help if someone wants to attempt to change which hat this mod replaces (it's a fairly simple edit, but it's up to individuals to figure out how to make it work, all you need is to edit the content.json with a text editor like Notepad++ (normal Notepad or Wordpad should work, but are a bit less intuitive for coding work)).

Installing this mod is simple, all you need to do is go over to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and follow the install instructions there, then drop this mod into your Mods folder.





I take no credit for this mod, since I didn't design the hat, all I did was make it available as a replacer. All credit goes to the game devs, and as always, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]PathosChild[/url]﻿ for all his awesome work on SMAPI and Content Patcher.
